name: HealthPartners volunteer program for high school students
what_you_do: High school volunteers work weekly shifts of two to four hours in HealthPartners hospitals and clinics. You get training in your department first.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 or older. High school students bring a reference form, a parent consent form and a health screening form to the interview. Some roles have higher age limits.
duration: Year-round program is at least 6 months and 100 hours. Summer program is 10 to 12 weeks.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The process takes about 3 to 4 weeks.
how_to_apply: Send the volunteer application and do an interview. Finish an online orientation. Pass a Minnesota background check. Then train on site. For questions, call 651-254-5709. You can also write to volunteerservices@healthpartners.com.
notes: The page does not name which hospitals take teens, so ask when you call.
